relationships.evidence_quote: decreased expression of p-AMPK (p < 0.001), SIRT1 (p < 0.001), NRF2 (p < 0.001), HO1 (p < 0.001), SOD2 (p < 0.001) and catalase (p < 0.001) when compared to normal control group

relationships.subject: cannabidiol

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: neuropathic mice with CBD and THCV treatment had elevated expressions of Nrf2, HO1, and catalase in DRGs

relationships.subject: tetrahydrocannabivarin
relationships.evidence_quote: we observed that CBD and THCV treatment elevated p-AMPK expression, and that their combination was superior in this effect

relationships.subject: 5-HT1A receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: we also observed that CBD’s anti-nociceptive effects are not dependent on CB1 activation, but rather on 5HT1A receptor activation

key_findings: CBD plus THCV combination reversed PTX-induced changes in AMPK, Nrf2/HO-1, p38 MAPK, PI3K/AKT and NLRP3 in DRG better than either alone.
CBD effects depend on 5-HT1A and THCV effects on CB1 receptors.
